blocks: The MicroFreak keys play a low G and the F below it at full velocity from 05:15, and the Launchpad shifts to a lower range. Saturate and Fold move from 06:00 to 06:59.
05:15 - the bass comes in - Infini Pad works great as a bass if the Microfreak/UI/Oscillator/Knob/Shape is turned up so the noise comes through.
07:05 - The minor seventh is a great bass interval.
The envelope's filter amount sweeps continuously from 07:30 to 08:59, with about 1,100 recorded changes. The cutoff knob stays where it is.
08:45 - the filter / cutoff adjustment, makes its warbly commentary.

The second layer stops at 09:02, just after a new third-layer take begins at 08:58. The cycling envelope's Rise, Amount, Fall and Hold are reshaped from 09:00, and the main envelope's sustain changes around 09:30.
From 09:30 the Launchpad phrases grow denser in a low-middle range.

Attack, decay and sustain change from 10:00 to 10:59. Spice (CC 2) and filter amount move from 11:26, and the synced LFO rate (CC 94) changes at 11:49. The second layer returns with a new take at 12:16.
Microfreak/UG/11 Icon Strip/03 Touch Strip/01 Spice and Dice

Noise, Saturate, Spice and filter amount move together from 13:00, followed by cycling-envelope Amount at 13:30 and more Noise at 14:00. Cutoff (CC 23) changes only once in the session, at 14:19–14:22.
The synced LFO rate changes again at 14:30–14:56, Spice returns at 15:00, and the cycling envelope is reshaped from 15:30.
13:00 - the long sky's cloud, the hair's blown face
13:50 - a cave of spectacles receives the formula
The first layer dips out at 16:22 and returns by 16:57; the third layer dips from 16:50 to 17:35. The Launchpad plays its last notes at 17:53, and no knob changes are recorded from 16:00 to 18:00.
17:00 - pulling back the grid, washing the curtain
17:58 — All right, that was all preset 259 Infini Pad.
